abort.already_configured: This mower is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The mower was moved to the new settings.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach an MQTT broker there.
error.invalid_auth: The broker turned down the username or password.
error.no_mower: The broker answers, but no OpenMower publishes behind that prefix (nothing on robot_state/json within 15 s). Check the prefix and that OpenMower is running.

data_description.host: Usually the mower itself, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or openmower.local.
data_description.prefix: Only if OpenMower publishes behind a prefix, e.g. openmower/. Empty on the mower's own broker.

data_description.host: Usually the mower itself, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or openmower.local.
data_description.prefix: Only if OpenMower publishes behind a prefix, e.g. openmower/. Empty on the mower's own broker.

user.description: The MQTT broker your OpenMower publishes to. MowBite talks to the mower directly, Home Assistant's own MQTT integration isn't needed.

action_unavailable.message: The mower doesn't take that right now.

error.cannot_reach_app: No MowBite answers at that address.
error.body_needed: Width and the lengths to the front and back are needed.
error.blade_too_big: The blade diameter can be at most 40 cm.

data_description.app_url: Where the MowBite app runs, e.g. http://openmower:8080. The map then has the colours and symbols set in the app. Empty: the app's defaults.
data_description.map: When the MowBite card shows the map, unless a card is set otherwise.
data_description.mower: For the mower's outline and the strip its blade cuts on the map. Sizes set in the MowBite app come first.

sizes.title: Own mower sizes
sizes.description: In cm, measured from the point OpenMower follows: the middle between the rear drive wheels. A blade of 0 draws only the outline.

data.bladeAhead: Blade ahead of the rear axle
data.bladeOffset: Blade to the left of the middle

options.app: As set in the MowBite app
